test_title: PYST 47 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Awareness (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: SPREE 2025 is a special initiative aimed at ___________ under the Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Act.

options.text: providing housing support to middle-income families
launching health insurance for gig workers
extending pension benefits to state employees

solution:
The correct answer is __**expanding social security coverage**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SPREE 2025** is a special initiative launched under the **Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Act** to enhance and expand **social security coverage** for workers.
 
• The scheme aims to bring more workers, especially those in the unorganized sector, under the ambit of the **ESI scheme**, ensuring access to benefits like **healthcare**, **sickness benefits**, **maternity benefits**, and **disability compensation**.
 
• The initiative focuses on ensuring that a broader section of the workforce benefits from **social security measures**, which include **medical care and financial assistance** during contingencies.
 
• Through SPREE 2025, efforts are being made to **increase registrations** of establishments and employees under the ESI Act, thus enabling access to **better social protection mechanisms**.
 
• The program aligns with the government’s broader goal of achieving **inclusive growth** and ensuring the welfare of workers by providing them with a **secure safety net**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Act:**

 
 
• The **ESI Act** was enacted in **1948** to provide **social security** to workers in case of sickness, maternity, injury, or death due to employment-related injuries.
 
• It applies to establishments with more than **10 employees** in specific industries, including factories and other notified sectors.
 
• Under the Act, covered employees and employers contribute a percentage of wages to the **ESI fund**, which is used to provide benefits.
 
 
 
• **Social Security Coverage in India:**
 
 
• Social security schemes in India aim to provide a **safety net** for workers, especially in times of financial or medical emergencies.
 
• Other major schemes include the **Atal Pension Yojana (APY)**, **PM-SYM**, and **National Pension Scheme (NPS)**.
 
• These schemes cover aspects like **retirement benefits**, **health insurance**, and **disability benefits**.
 
 
 
• **Unorganized Sector Workforce:**
 
 
• India has over **42 crore workers** in the unorganized sector, which constitutes a significant portion of the total workforce.
 
• Efforts like SPREE 2025 aim to **formalize employment** and extend benefits to these workers, ensuring better job security and social welfare.
 
 
 
• **Key Benefits of ESI Scheme:**
 
 
• **Medical Benefits:** Free medical care to insured persons and their families.
 
• **Sickness Benefits:** Cash compensation during certified periods of sickness.
 
• **Maternity Benefits:** Paid leave during pregnancy or childbirth.
 
• **Disability Benefits:** Compensation for temporary or permanent physical disability.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **SPREE 2025:** It focuses specifically on enhancing the **reach of the ESI scheme** and ensuring benefits reach a greater number of employees.
 
• **Eligibility:** The ESI Act applies to employees earning less than a specified wage limit (currently **₹21,000 per month**).
 
• **Implementation:** The initiative is being executed by **Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)**, which oversees the administration of the ESI scheme.
 
• **Future Goals:** SPREE 2025 aims to achieve universal social security coverage for all workers, including those in informal sectors, by the year **2025**.
